about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm Xue He-Sheng — known in the dev community as Casual Attitude. I'm a software engineer focused on test and release automation on Apple platforms: XCTest suites, CI/CD pipelines, and the tooling that keeps fast-moving teams shipping reliable iOS and macOS software.
about.journey: My path started at the NTUT Programming Club, where I served as extracurricular president, hosted 12+ knowledge-sharing workshops, and partnered with Google to bring its Machine Learning Crash Course to campus. I then led a 6-person team to ship TAT, NTUT's campus app — 10K+ downloads at 4.3★ — and kept it running through years of breaking portal and authentication changes. That's where I learned that shipping is the easy part; keeping software reliable is the real work.
about.current: Today at buho Interactive I own test and release automation for cross-platform Apple titles. I run the Xcode → TestFlight → App Store pipeline, hold a stable 60 fps across 300+ releases, keep crash-free sessions at 99%, and collapsed a 1-hour manual build into a single ~5-second chat command. I also built and self-host an internal LLM agent (FastAPI, LangChain, Chroma) guarded by a 40+ contract pytest suite — testing AI systems the same way I test apps.
about.passion: I care most about the input experience. I built AIKeyboard, a custom iOS keyboard extension (Swift, SwiftUI) with a headless XCTest suite that runs on the Simulator on every build — working within the text-input pipeline, extension lifecycle, and Apple's input-API constraints. I break ambiguous goals into testable contracts, automate the repetitive, debug the hard failures, and make every ship decision rest on evidence.
